description: This file defines a class 'KubernetesHostingOptionsValidator' that implements validation logic for 'KubernetesHostingOptions' in the context of the Orleans project. It checks whether the namespace and pod name are set, and reports validation failures if not.

classes.name: KubernetesHostingOptionsValidator
classes.description: A class responsible for validating 'KubernetesHostingOptions' configurations in Orleans Hosting for Kubernetes.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Performs validation on 'KubernetesHostingOptions' instance, checking if 'Namespace' and 'PodName' are set, and returns the validation result.
